text: While you were obviously asleep, I've already gained new insights of this place.
zh: 你显然还在呼呼大睡的时候，我已经对这地方有了新的发现。

text: A new energy now emanates from the stones that was not felt before.
zh: 如今这些石头散发出一股前所未有的新能量。

text: I will now connect my mind with these energies using the astral powers.
zh: 现在，我要借助星界之力，将我的心智与这些能量相连。

text: My body will be completely defenseless, so you have to make sure nothing happens to me.
zh: 届时我的身体将毫无防备，所以你必须确保我不出任何意外。

text: Are you ready for the ritual?
zh: 你准备好进行仪式了吗？

text: You're not as useless as I thought.
No matter what happens, make sure my body is not damaged!
zh: 无论发生什么，都要保证我的身体毫发无损！
